name: compare
description: Use this when the user wants every store's price for one product, whether a price is good or a deal right now (Black Friday, rea), or its price history and lowest price in the last 30/90 days. Not for finding products: search first unless the name carries model numbers. Offers from Prisjakt and PriceRunner, cheapest first by total (price + shipping) when shipping is known, sold-out last; a store on both sites is one row (price, shipping, total, stock and url from one offer; seen_on has each site's price). Also cheapest (new), cheapest_secondhand and cheapest_in_stock, skipping sold-out offers unless nothing else is listed; Prisjakt's price history (lowest new price per day, 30/90-day and all-time lows) and a verdict on the current price against it, naming a cheaper offer listed only on PriceRunner. A site without the product's key is looked up by name.

arguments.name: in_stock_only
arguments.desc: List only offers the site reports in stock. Default false.

arguments.name: include_used
arguments.desc: Also list used and refurbished offers. Default false: new only (unknown condition counts as new). cheapest_secondhand is reported either way.

arguments.name: product
arguments.desc: A key from search ('prisjakt:123+pricerunner:456'), a Prisjakt or PriceRunner product page URL, or a plain product name with its model numbers, e.g. 'airpods pro 3', 'samsung qe55q80d'. Names follow search's query rules: Swedish or English, brand and model in Latin letters, no intent words (billigast, pris, köpa). The first search result carrying the model numbers is used; none = not found.

name: search
description: Use this when the user wants to know where a product is cheapest in Sweden, to compare store prices, or what something costs in Swedish shops (Elgiganten, Power, NetOnNet, Webhallen, Inet, Komplett, CDON and others, via Prisjakt and PriceRunner). Not for second-hand classified ads (Blocket, Tradera) or prices outside Sweden. Returns products, both sites' listings merged when they are the same model: key (pass to compare), name, brand, category, image, rating, per site the lowest new and used/refurbished price, offer count and url (sources), match (name; null for one site) and cheapest (lowest new price; used never counts). used_query shows the words searched when they differ from query; hint says what to try when nothing is found; errors lists a site that failed while the other answered.

arguments.name: max_price
arguments.desc: Highest price, SEK incl. VAT, e.g. 1000 for 'under 1000 kr'.

arguments.name: min_price
arguments.desc: Lowest price, SEK incl. VAT, e.g. 500 for 'över 500 kr'.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Product or category in Swedish or English, e.g. 'robotdammsugare roborock', 'tvättmaskin bosch', 'iphone 16 128gb', 'dubbdäck 205/55 r16'. Translate category words from other languages into Swedish (наушники → hörlurar). Brand + model + the spec that matters (128gb, 55 tum, 205/55 r16); colours in Swedish (svart, vit). No intent words: billig/billigast/cheapest, köpa/buy, pris/price, bästa/best, deal/rea, begagnad/used, ny/new. Price limits go in min_price/max_price, not here. One product or category per query.

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: Sites to search, default both: ['prisjakt'], ['pricerunner'] or both.
